profile.aboutStory: 9Paws was created to make personal expense tracking and group bill splitting easy, joyful, and cozy—like having Miu Miu by your side every day.
profile.aboutDevSchool: University of Information Technology Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
profile.missionContent: 9Paws was created to transform daily expense tracking into a warm, cozy, and delightful experience alongside our cute mascot Miu Miu.
profile.featureExpenseDesc: Intuitive tracking with flexible cash, bank, and e-wallet management.
profile.featureSplitDesc: Fair and effortless bill splitting for trips and dining with friends.
profile.featureCompanionDesc: Gentle daily bedtime reminders to keep your financial habit on track.
profile.featureSecurityDesc: Protect your financial records with Face ID or Fingerprint lock.
profile.privacyCommitment1Desc: 9Paws never snoops on your bank credentials, SMS/OTPs, or sells your personal data.
profile.privacyCommitment2Desc: All transaction history is encrypted and securely stored following modern security standards.
profile.privacyCommitment3Desc: You retain full ownership to export, edit, or delete your account and financial data anytime.
